description: GET /api/stock-records responds with Content-Type application/json, never text/html, both when rows exist and when the table is empty
GET /api/skus/{sku}/stock-records responds with Content-Type application/json, never text/html, both for a SKU with records and for an unknown SKU
The integration test session fixture refuses to run unless DATABASE_URL is a postgresql URL, so the S3 list and SKU-detail reads never run against sqlite or an in-memory engine
